get_hermes_home: get the Hermes home directory path, reading HERMES_HOME env var or falling back to ~/.hermes
get_default_hermes_root: get the root Hermes directory for profile-level operations, resolving profile and Docker deployments
get_hermes_dir: resolve a Hermes subdirectory with backward compatibility, preferring new paths but falling back to legacy ones
apply_ipv4_preference: monkey-patch socket.getaddrinfo to prefer IPv4 connections, avoiding IPv6 timeout hangs
parse_reasoning_effort: parse a reasoning effort level string into a config dict with enabled flag and effort value
